case_title.correct_value: Asim Shariff v. National Investigation Agency
case_title.quote: ASIM SHARIFF v. NATIONAL INVESTIGATION AGENCY

number_of_accused.quote: registered along with four other accused persons

accused_gender.reason: Gender is never expressly stated; only inferred from names and 'he'.

accused_occupation.correct_value: President of Bengaluru unit of Popular Front of India (PFI)
accused_occupation.quote: the appellant is the President of Bengaluru unit of Popular Front of India(PFI)
accused_occupation.reason: Broadly right, but this is an organisational position, not necessarily occupation; ASG called him District President.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No criminal record of appellant stated.

victim_gender.quote: hacked Rudresh with a sharp edged and lethal machete
victim_gender.reason: Victim Rudresh referred to as male; deceased attacked; consistent.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: No animosity/personal relationship; victim targeted as RSS member
accused_victim_relationship.quote: Admittedly, there is no animosity between the appellant and deceased.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Stranger is a reasonable inference but not expressly stated.

offence_category.correct_value: Murder, criminal conspiracy and terrorist/unlawful activities offences
offence_category.quote: Sections 120-B, 109, 150, 153A, 302, 201 read with Section 34 of IPC
offence_category.reason: Murder is only one of the charged categories.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 120-B, 109, 150, 153A, 302, 201 read with Section 34 of IPC

weapon.quote: hacked Rudresh with a sharp edged and lethal machete

evidence_type.correct_value: Circumstantial (call records, banner, letter, disclosure report); confession of accused no. 4 alleged
evidence_type.quote: Several telephone exchanges between accused no. 1 to 4 and the accused appellant.
evidence_type.reason: Medical evidence not mentioned; confession only alleged by prosecution.

confession.correct_value: Prosecution alleges accused no. 4 confessed appellant was the mastermind; not tested by court
confession.quote: Accused no. 4 confesses that accused appellant was the mastermind
confession.reason: Only the ASG's submission, not a finding.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Alleged conspiracy to kill RSS members and create fear (prosecution submissions only)
aggravating_circumstances.quote: to create fear in the minds of the people at large and to create insecurity
aggravating_circumstances.reason: These are prosecution allegations, not court-found aggravating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.quote: The application filed under Section 227 Cr.P.C. by the accused No.5 is hereby dismissed.

high_court_outcome.quote: confirmed the view expressed by the trial Judge

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal dismissed; discharge refused, charges to be framed; no conviction

offence_finally_established.correct_value: None established; only prima facie case for framing charges
offence_finally_established.quote: truth & veracity of such conspiracy is to be examined during the course of trial

neutral_facts.correct_value: Murder of Rudresh on 16.10.2016 by machete attack; NIA charge-sheet alleged PFI members conspired; call records, banner, letter cited; accused sought discharge
neutral_facts.quote: hacked Rudresh with a sharp edged and lethal machete on the right side of his neck
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate, but omits discharge procedural context and the letter was found at appellant's office.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment gives no punishment ranges; 'minimum 7 years' for s.302 is wrong anyway.

attempt_completion.quote: Rudresh was taken to a hospital wherein he was declared brought dead.

physical_harm.quote: hacked Rudresh with a sharp edged and lethal machete on the right side of his neck

number_of_offences.reason: Many more than 5 sections charged; none 'upheld'.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Court found only prima facie material of conspiracy, to be tested at trial
premeditation_planning.quote: prima facie material of conspiracy among the accused persons

motive.correct_value: Alleged to kill RSS members and spread terror/insecurity
motive.quote: conspired with the accused appellant(accused no. 5) to kill RSS members
motive.reason: Motive alleged by prosecution; 'Not identified' is wrong.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: frequent telephonic/mobile conversation between appellant(accused no. 5) with other accused persons
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Consistent with court's prima facie reliance.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Court did not assess witness credibility; that was an appellant argument
witness_credibility.quote: CW 1 to 53, 55 to 76... did not whisper anything against the appellant
witness_credibility.reason: Attributes appellant's argument to the court; no credibility assessment.

custody_duration.correct_value: Appellant arrested 2 November 2016; total duration not stated
custody_duration.quote: Accused no. 5(appellant herein) was arrested on 2nd November, 2016.

trial_duration.correct_value: Case registered 16.10.2016; charge-sheet 21.04.2017; discharge order 2.1.2018; HC 22.11.2018; SC 1.7.2019; trial not completed
trial_duration.quote: final report was submitted before the trial Court against the accused persons 1 to 5 on 21st April, 2017
trial_duration.reason: Dates mostly right but 'trial judgment' is mischaracterised; only discharge order.

legal_representation.quote: Kamini Jaiswal, Abdul Rahiman, Shereef K.A., Ms. Rani Mishra, Jatinderpal Singh., Advs. for the Appellant.

investigation_status.correct_value: Charge sheet filed 21 April 2017; trial not completed, charges yet to be framed
investigation_status.quote: the case on hand deserves to be proceeded with framing of charge

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: None found by court; sanction objection was raised and dealt with by trial court
procedural_irregularity.quote: it is not good to pass any orders in respect of sanction
procedural_irregularity.reason: Largely right; sanction issue existed but court found no error.

appeal_history.quote: With these observations, the appeal is dismissed.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Also argued UAPA applies without scheduling; PFI links, banner, calls, letter, indoctrination classes, confession
prosecution_argument.quote: series of evidence reveals the appellant's involvement in the commission of crime
prosecution_argument.reason: Correct in gist but omits specific evidence and UAPA argument.

defence_argument.correct_value: No material against appellant; witnesses said nothing; mere suspicion; Navaratri date discrepancy; PFI not banned so UAPA not attracted
defence_argument.quote: none of the accused in this case are the member of any terrorist organisation which are banned

legal_principle_applied.quote: has the undoubted power to sift and weigh the evidence for the limited purpose of finding out whether or not a prima facie case

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Union of India Vs. Prafulla Kumar Samal
